newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Netanyahu sees agreement on Hebron soon - Austria.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu sees agreement on Hebron soon - Austria.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told Austrian Chancellor Franz Vranitzky in a telephone call on Tuesday he expected to finalise a self-rule accord with the PLO over Hebron within days, Vranitzky said.
"There are only a few missing elements as far as Hebron is concerned, he told me," Vranitzky said at a news conference in Vienna which was also attended by Palestinian President Yasser Arafat.
Netanyahu expected these elements to be overcome within the "next few days," Vranitzky added.
Arafat, who said he last spoke to Netanyahu on the phone two days ago, stressed he was prepared to meet the Israeli Prime Minister "anytime, any place."

He said the two leaders agreed to continue the peace process. "We, the Palestinians, are committed completely to the peace process and all the agreements we signed and hope Mr Netanyahu to be committed also and implement accurately and honestly the agreement," Arafat told the news conference.

Israeli-PLO tensions mounted in the last week over Israel's decision to grant financial benefits to Jewish settlers, the killing of a settler mother and her son by Arab gunmen, and the fatal shooting of an Arab worker by a Jewish farmer.
